title: We made a game creation and editing tool using AI
author: _exists_ai
selftext:
Hey guys!

We've been working on this in stealth for almost a year and now its ready for a limited usage, more of alpha testing stage. The AI game creation tool that we've created allows consumers to create games using prompts and customization options. We're super excited and eager to have more people test it - the alpha is ongoing! The link for scheduling tests is in our Discord, and we also encourage people to come visit us there, share their thoughts and feedback too, of course. Looking forward to seeing u all there!

comments.author: PowerOk3024
comments.body: This looks amazing. Really liking the techs speedy advancement and the ppl pushing it forward
